name: Stereo Garden

evidence.note: Official site: former roller rink with over 20,000 sq ft of open, column-free floor; 21+ unless stated.
Club 30+ on Sat Oct 3, 5-9 pm: club-style party with DJs, disco balls and confetti.
Listing describes three bars, a full stage, a dance floor and a VIP area.

dancing.notes: The old roller-rink floor gives lots of open space in front of the stage. Club 30+ is a daytime club party with DJs playing 80s, 90s and 2000s hits, made for dancing.

description: A large multi-use music venue and event hall in Patchogue village, built as a 1940s roller rink, with a stage, two bars, multiple levels and a beer garden.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Phone numbers differ: the website shows (631) 416-7755, while Bing lists (631) 699-8151 (the events/brunch contact). Club 30+ is a touring party brand run by an outside promoter, ticketed, 21+.
